significance: A Shiva temple at about 2,200 m in the Urgam valley, the fifth of the Panch Kedar shrines and the only one open to pilgrims all year. Its priestly line was appointed by Adi Shankara.
story: The matted locks of the bull-form of Shiva are said to have appeared at Kalpeshwar, where the Pandavas then raised a temple.
